entities.name: The Antiquities War
aliases: The Story of Urza and Mishra
entities.description: An in-universe classic of Argivian literature by Kayla bin-Kroog, here translated and annotated in two volumes by Taysir of Rabiah.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: The translator and commentator of the excerpts.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: The author of The Antiquities War, who felt ignored by Urza and had a relationship with Tawnos.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A brother who holds the Mightstone, develops a guild-like structure under the King of Kroog's patronage, and fights Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A brother who holds the Weakstone, confederates the Fallaji tribes, and is changed by his journey to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The head of the archeological school the brothers joined, killed in the contest between them.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A cold figure alongside Mishra who crossed into Phyrexia with him and committed atrocities.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: A figure about whom Kayla makes a cutting comment.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: A scholar who made many trips to Phyrexia and never returned from the last; author of the Codex Phyrexia.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: A Thran stone of power that draws power from objects, kept by Mishra; opened a gate to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: The Thran stone of power, opposite to the Weakstone, kept by Urza.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: Desert nomads who searched for Thran artifacts and were confederated by Mishra.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A religious order whose abbey was destroyed after the Battle of Teonacall.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city whose king patronized Urza and which was destroyed by Dragon Engines.

entities.name: Korliss
entities.description: A neutral territory where the failed trading conference was held.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A hideous plane of mechanical beasts and demons, reached by Mishra through a gate in the cave of Koilos.

entities.name: Cave of Koilos
entities.description: The cave in the Western Desert where the stones were found and the gate to Phyrexia opened.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra that spread across Yotia and the Great Desert, destroying Kroog.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: A mysterious empire that fell thousands of years before the brothers.

entities.name: Dragon Engines
entities.description: Fearsome Phyrexian machines that followed Mishra and Ashnod back and burned Kroog.

events.summary: After their parents' deaths, the brothers Urza and Mishra come to an archeological school, where their tale begins.
events.quote: Following the deaths of their parents, the two brothers came to one of the archeological schools.

events.summary: In the contest between the brothers Tocasia is killed and her school is probably destroyed; each keeps one stone.
events.quote: As a result of the contest, Tocasia was killed and her school was most likely destroyed.

events.summary: Mishra confederates various Fallaji tribes under his central control.
events.quote: Over time, Mishra was able to confederate various tribes under his central control.

events.summary: Urza, under the patronage of the King of Kroog, develops a guild-like structure of apprentices.
events.quote: Urza, under the patronage of the King of Kroog, developed something akin to a guild structure

events.summary: The trading conference at Korliss ends in an attack that provokes the brothers' struggle into open conflict.
events.quote: It provoked the brothers' struggle into open conflict.

events.summary: The Fallaji lure the Kroog forces deep into the Western Desert, leaving Kroog undefended.
events.quote: By luring the Kroog forces deeper into the Western Desert, the Fallaji accomplished two things

events.summary: Mishra journeys to Phyrexia and returns changed, darker and more dangerous.
events.quote: Whatever the interpretation, it is plain that Mishra's character changes drastically at this point, becoming darker and more dangerous.

events.summary: Mishra and Ashnod cross into Phyrexia through a gate the Weakstone opened in the cave of Koilos.
events.quote: we are told earlier that Mishra and Ashnod crossed over into the world of Phyrexia through a gate that the Weakstone opened for them in the cave of Koilos

events.summary: Kroog is destroyed by Dragon Engines, the first city destroyed by the Brothers' War.
events.quote: Kroog was the first city, but certainly not the last, to be destroyed by the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Mishra builds his stronghold on the foundation of the School of Tocasia in the Kher Ridges.
events.quote: Mishra's stronghold was found in the Kher Ridges -- built on the foundation of the School of Tocasia.

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix's abbey is destroyed and its members scattered after the Battle of Teonacall.
events.quote: Its abbey was destroyed and its members scattered following the Battle of Teonacall.

events.summary: Delegates of various factions meet at the Ivory Tower council, taking a first step toward understanding mana.
events.quote: Sources state that the council of the Ivory Tower was attended by delegates representing various political, religious, and tribal affiliations present in Terisiare.

events.summary: The brothers struggle together against a Phyrexian demon, the black heart, in the desert.
events.quote: it is believed that the brothers struggled with a Phyrexian demon that might have entered Terisiare through the gateway in the cave of Koilos
